description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Warwick''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|leaps]] in the target direction with [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|crowd control immunity]], stopping upon hitting an enemy champion. He then [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|knocks them down]] and [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] for up to 1.5 seconds to [[File:Suppression icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|An icon representing the keyword Suppression]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|suppress]], [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|reveal]], and deal magic damage every 0.25 seconds, [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|revealing]] himself in the process. This damage [[:Life steal|applies]] [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal.
description.text: Active: Warwick leaps in the target direction with crowd control immunity, stopping upon hitting an enemy champion. He then knocks them down and channels for up to 1.5 seconds to suppress, reveal, and deal magic damage every 0.25 seconds, revealing himself in the process. This damage applies  life steal.

description3.raw: '''Warwick''' [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] for 100% of all post-mitigation damage he deals to the target during ''Infinite Duress''.
description3.text: Warwick heals for 100% of all post-mitigation damage he deals to the target during Infinite Duress.

description4.raw: ''Infinite Duress'' both applies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and triggers [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects 3 times over its duration.
description4.text: Infinite Duress both applies on-hit effects and triggers on-attack effects 3 times over its duration.

description5.raw: ''[[File:Warwick Primal Howl.png|20xpx|border|link=Warwick#Primal Howl|An icon for Warwick's ability Primal Howl]] [[Warwick#Primal Howl|Primal Howl]] can be cast during the dash.''
description5.text: Primal Howl can be cast during the dash.

notes.text:
Infinite Duress deals basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
The minimum range of the ability is 275 units, based on the minimum movement speed that a champion can have (110) while still being able to move. The "base" range of this ability is 837.5 because of his 335 base movement speed.
* Considering movement speed soft caps, with Blood Hunt, this range increases to 1112 / 1162.25 / 1203.125 / 1234.53125 / 1265.9375, further increased to 1286.875 / 1349.6875 / 1412.5 / 1475.3125 / 1538.125 toward enemy champions below 25% health.
Infinite Duress deals a total of 6 damage instances:
* The 1st, 3rd, and 5th ticks deals 2/9ths of the total damage as a single instance while applying both spell and on-hit effects, and triggering on-attack effects.
* The 2nd, 4th, and 6th ticks deal 1/9ths of the total damage as a single instance while applying spell effects but not on-hit effects.
If Warwick does not collide with a champion, he will slide a fixed distance past the maximum range during which he is no longer crowd control immune and unable to declare basic attacks or cast movement abilities, including Flash, but being able to cast Jaws of the Beast and Blood Hunt, with the former also interrupting the slide.
* Warwick is able to cast Primal Howl at any time during the dash.
Activating Zhonya's Hourglass during the dash interrupts it.
Each hit counts as a separate cast instance for effects such as Electrocute and Eclipse's Ever Rising Moon.
Warwick gains the cc-immunity at the start of the cast time.
Cleansing the suppression does not interrupt the channel and Warwick will continue to strike but not deal any damage.
* Infinite Duress is special cased to have its channel interrupted by Fate's Call.
If the target is crowd control immune or protected by spell shield upon collision, Warwick will not start the channel.
* Spell shield will not prevent the effects of Infinite Duress if Warwick is already channeling.
If the target is in a zombie state, Warwick will stop the channel after ~0.5 seconds of hitting them.(bug)
Infinite Duress covers Warwick's hitbox, meaning he will collide with enemy champions that are particularly close to him.
Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts' Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence's Frostfire Tempest will activate at the end of the dash. If the dash collides with an enemy, the items are instead activated after 0.45 seconds into the channel, and the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the channel.
